Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the thoughtful Qs. Dropping recording, slides, and a short set of clarifications + owners so we can move from conversation -> action. Recording: https://redwood.company/ah/1954321987/recording  Slides: https://redwood.company/ah/1954321987/slides

Samir: Quick Q — you said Dedicated GA in July. What guarantees will come with GA (uptime, latency SLOs, data residency)?

Maya: Good callout. GA includes an SLA (99.95% availability) and a latency SLO for 95th pct tail at planned capacity. Data residency options will be region-based; Private still required for strict on-prem residency. See GA spec: https://redwood.company/docs/dedicated-ga and @Samir can you own a short FAQ blurb for customers?

Samir: I can take the FAQ, thanks. I'll draft today and ping for review.

Jordan: For teams on Hosted who want to move to Dedicated, whats the recommended migration path? Any data transfer costs?

Priya: Migration plan: 1) export usage + prompt sets via admin export; 2) provision Dedicated seat and run shadowing for 48-72h; 3) cutover with traffic-split (10% -> 50% -> 100%). We will waive ingress transfer fees for the first 90 days for pilot customers. Filing SRV-3421 to track docs + checklist.

Jordan: Nice, can you add a simple checklist for PMs / Eng to follow?

Priya: Yep — I'll add the checklist to SRV-3421 and drop a short template here by EOD tomorrow.

Maya: A couple of other clarifications from questions in the Q&A: 
- Redwood Optimize experiments (model/quantization recs) will be on by default for new Dedicated tenants but can be disabled per-route.
- Canary rollouts: Console will support A/B policy rules and automatic fallback to hosted models if Dedicated capacity is exhausted.
- Pricing: no change to hosted per-token billing, Dedicated is a committed monthly seat + per-token overage. Full docs linked in the roadmap page.

Samir: @Maya re: canary fallback — can we log fallback events to the Conductor so ops can alert on regressions?

Maya: Yes — that is in the rollout telemetry plan. Ops events will surface in Console and push to PagerDuty when fallback rate > 1% over 5m.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded to /company-drive/AllHands/1954321987.mp4 :white_check_mark:

Priya: Action items I have so far: 
- SRV-3421: Migration checklist + template (owner: Priya, due: 2026-04-02)
- FAQ: Dedicated GA customer-facing blurb (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-24)
- Console telemetry: fallback events to PD (owner: EngReliability team, requestor: Maya, tracking: TR-8910)

Maya: I'll consolidate these into the leadership follow-up doc and ping owners night/day depending on timezones. If anyone else took notes with additional asks, drop them here and we'll assign. Thanks again — quick wins and some medium-weight tasks but good momentum. :rocket:

Jordan: Dropping a note to volunteer for user-testing migration docs with two pilot customers I know. Happy to help onboard/test the checklist.

Samir: Thanks — I'll ping you once I have the FAQ draft.

Maya: Great. Closing with the ask: please update the tracking issues or comment on SRV-3421 when you start work so we don't duplicate. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
